Results.ReviewText: Weber is the best, nothing else like it. Really like the added features...
Results.Title: Barbecue

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Added a vortex and Slow-n-Sear and this grill now does it all. I’m very happy and have been cooking a couple times a week.
Results.Title: No substitute for a Weber

Results.ReviewText: Best grill for the money.  Easy to use and the food taste great.  The only negative is the legs could be better.
Results.Title: Weber master touch

Results.ReviewText: I am a Weber grill lover and own many. This was a beautiful addition to my Weber family. I grill at least 4 times per week and it’s always on a Weber charcoal grill or smoker.
Results.Title: Wonderful addition to the family.

Results.ReviewText: Most of my experience is only ever cooking on a Weber. I have went from using a Jumbo Joe to a Master Touch, which was a huge upgrade. The hinged grill grate and charcoal baskets where among the best in my opinion. So much easier for fire management and maintains a consistent temperature throughout the cook. It also has a great damper system on the bottom for temperature control as well. It stands higher the the other kettles and a great placement for the lid. Spend a few more dollars on these great features. You won’t be disappointed
Results.Title: Weber quality

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for being a Weber fan! We appreciate your feedback regarding the Master-Touch charcoal grill. We are so sorry to learn of the cracks in the enamel. We are happy to help. Our Support team is reaching out to assist you further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: There was significant chips/ cracks in the side of the body, near where it meets the lid.
Results.Title: Cracks in the coating

Results.ReviewText: Simply put, it's the best charcoal kettle money can buy. I would definitely recommend it to anyone, no matter the level of expertise, it will not disappoint you.
Results.Title: The best charcoal kettle

Results.ReviewText: An excellent platform with great quality.  Versatile, comfortable with a wide variety of options for a better barbecue.  Thanks
Results.Title: Master Touch

Results.ReviewText: I have owned charcoal grills for years. Finally decided to go with the best.
Results.Title: Weber Grills Are The Best!

Results.ReviewText: I’ve been happy with my purchase so far and I have bought most of the options for the GBS. My only criticism is my lower damper/ash component slightly warped after a few cooks and should not of done so that quickly. My other disappointment is you cannot purchase the heat deflector in Canada.
Results.Title: Overall a top charcoal bbq

Results.ReviewText: Using the grill is easy to clean up less mess, love the pot design to catch the ashes, and very great to use while on the beach or camping. Very durable and strong.
Results.Title: Great Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill does everything I want it to do. Sear and smoke. I previously bought an expensive pellet grill and this grill puts it to shame. I wish I would have saved my money and just got a master touch from the get go.
Results.Title: Perfect for me

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill! It’s been fun working with Charcoal, I know this thing will last for a long time!
Results.Title: Clean and mean! Love my Weber

Results.ReviewText: Love my new master touch. Easy to use. Works great!
Results.Title: Excellent

Results.ReviewText: Only thing there was a chip in the paint by the top handle
Results.Title: Need touch up paint but other then that i love it

Results.ReviewText: Seems to be well thought out and very simple to assemble and use.
Results.Title: General Observations

Results.ReviewText: I grew up with a weber kettle grill and have always wanted to own one for myself one day. I did my first cook and if we captured memories of my youth with the weber grill slow smoking in the backyard while I played some ball with my dad and brother. The general design hasn’t changed much over the years and I am very glad for that as it worked like a charm. There have been a few handy little improvements, like the shielded lid handle, which works great. I’ve included photos below for my first smoked beer chicken. Just a bit of salt and pepper and a chunk of hickory added to the briquettes. Cooked it indirectly in the centre with the baskets to the side, low and slow.
Results.Title: Simplicity at its finest!

Photos.Caption: 26 inch kettle with entire 2 lb bag of wings from Costco

Results.ReviewText: I returned it and got the 26 inch kettle. I didn't realize how small the cooking area would be, especially with indirect grilling area, and didn't like cleaning the new grill style. I'm happy with the 26 inch grill and grate it comes with.
Results.Title: Got the 26 inch after all

Results.ReviewText: I didn't just purchase it, but I did register it. It's been great these last 5 years.
Results.Title: Master touch has been awesome for the last 5 years

Results.ReviewText: I've been using Weber charcoal grills for 30 some years and I'll never use anything else.
Results.Title: The only grill I'll ever use.

Results.ReviewText: I bought this kettle about 3 weeks ago because I heard so much good things about it and I love it !!! I like it because it's so versatile, you can go high heat and low and slow. I already did ribs and burgers on it and so far so good!! Thanks Weber for such an awesome bbq.
Results.Title: Excellent BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Never was interested in charcoal cooking. I seen some Ti-Tok videos and bought a Weber. I have enjoyed cooking the food as much as eating it.
Results.Title: Weber

Results.ReviewText: Really great grill.  I wish I would have bought it a long time ago.
Results.Title: New grill

Results.ReviewText: This is an terrific grill.  You can do almost anything with it.  I was concerned about low and slow, but my pork belly burnt ends turned out wonderful cooked at 250 for several hours and then finished off at 350.  It pairs great with my pellet grill and I sometimes use both for the same cook.  I love my pellet grill, and it is best for really long low and slow cooks (like a brisket), but you can’t beat the reverse sear with some lump charcoal after a 30 minute smoke on the pellet grill.   There are so many great videos on YouTube to show you how to make the most of this grill. You can’t go wrong.
Results.Title: Great versatile grill.

Results.ReviewText: So far very good. Glad to be back on charcoal. I did have a issue with water getting in the temp gauge and had a reply to just light the bbq and let it dry out. well it did dry out but left a discolored white gauge on a day old bbq. I have used it twice since and cooks great. I think the water got in while rinsing off the bbq. Still I think its a weak area, should be able to handle a hose pipe .
Results.Title: Time will tell

Results.ReviewText: Easy assembly.  Looks great!  Only used a couple of times since I got it, but works great.
Results.Title: GREAT AS EXPECTED

Results.ReviewText:
I spent a lot of time and research before I bought the Weber Master Touch Charcoal Grill 22'' 1 month ago and I'm delighted with this Charcoal grill.
The Gourmet BBQ system cooking grate and Char baskets are a great addition so you get a lot for your money. The construction of this grill is superior to other similarly priced charcoal grills and will last well beyond Weber's 10 year warranty.
Cooking and smoking on this grill is a joy and I love the One touch cleaning system.
Results.Title: Great value for the money.

Results.ReviewText: Great BBQ and even you can use it to smoke meat.  The onetouch cleaning system works great, the lid holder its awesome.  I love the BBQ overall including the accessories.
Results.Title: Great BBQ and even you can use it to smoke meat

Results.ReviewText: This is the only grill anybody needs to own. You can do everything with it including grill, smoke, cold smoke, etc. this is my third one and I will not buy any other grill from here on out
Results.Title: Best grill ever!

Results.ReviewText: I’m grilling the best food I’ve ever made, I’ve don ribs, chuck roast, briskets, chicken and everything has been amazing
Results.Title: Love my Deep Ocean Blue master touch

Results.ReviewText: Just what I wanted, it’s versatile and easy to keep your temperature.
Results.Title: Finally got one, so should you.

Results.ReviewText: Been super fun to use. Very versatile!! Excellent results as I continue to put this grill to the test.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use and clean, hold temperatures is very easy.
Results.Title: BBQ 1,2,3

Results.ReviewText: Très content de mon achat. Ne prends pas trop d'espace , facile d'utilisation et très versatile
Results.Title: Super simple , de qualité et fonctionnel

Results.ReviewText: I bought this today. Set up was quick and simple. I grilled some steak and after smoked some ribs. I usually smoke on an offset smoker and was curious to see how it would go as I used to talk smack to people who "smoked" on a charcoal grill. My goodness I could not believe the results!! Everything about the ribs and process of cooking was literally set it and forget it! Came out better than on my offset smoker!!! After today I eat my words. Very happy with the purchase and even happier with my steak and ribs. Just Wow!
Results.Title: Just Wow!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. My 4th kettle. I really like the warming rack and heavy duty grill. The center part comes out so you can put in a pizza stone or a wok. I'll never use that but I'm sure some people will. As always this is a well built grill that will last 10 to 20 years depending on how often you use it. I love the blue color.
Results.Title: Everything you need and then some

Results.ReviewText: J'ai mon Master Touch depuis 2 ans et toujours aussi satisfait. La garantie de Weber est fiable et le service est exceptionnel. Ce BBQ est parfait pour tout type de cuisson et pour le fumage également.
Results.Title: Le meilleur BBQ pour le prix !

Results.ReviewText: I recieved my first weber for a wedding present 42 years ago, as a charcoal purist thats the only grill I used for 40 years. just 2 webers. 2 yrs ago I effed up and bought a barrel style grill from a big box store. the charcoal rack burned through in 2 summers. I  consider myself to be an experienced griller but I could not get used to a non-weber grill. a blessing in disguise the one burnt out because I got to go back to my old pal. my new Weber's home is northern wisconsin so she's going to smell like Brats. first cookout was in 5 degree weather February 19, and she performed flawlessly, Brats of course, Miller High Life on the side. Life is good again
Results.Title: back in the saddle again

Results.ReviewText: After years on a gas grill, I decided to go back to my roots and grill on the same thing my dad used. A Weber kettle. So easy to regulate heat and the kettle maintains its temperature for s long as you need with little adjustment. Love the added flavor from the smoke that was always missing, using a gas grill
Results.Title: Simple, time proven, grilling

Results.ReviewText:
This is a well made product. The grill appears to be made such that it will last a long time.  I especially like the venting.  When cooking burgers with the vents opened the flames picked up due to fat droppings on the coals.  Closing the vents shut the flames down, then partially opening the vents kept the flames from returning. 
I am looking forward to trying out the rotisserie i purchased which will be a new experience for me.
Results.Title: High quality grill built to last.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, love the features upgrading from Original Premium Kettle to Master-Touch...additional height is a backsaver!
Results.Title: Best Grill Ever!

Results.ReviewText: Upgraded myself from the original to Weber Master Touch.  Easy to put together after watching YT videos.  The quality is still there.  Also my old was still going strong and didn't last long in the front yard.  It found a new home after 10 years.
Results.Title: Treated myself to a upgrade charcoal grill.

Results.ReviewText: Love the grille. Had a small crack in the porcelain when I got it and customer service was amazing at helping me replacing the main bowl.
Results.Title: 22 master touch

Results.ReviewText: Amazing value for the money! Classic Weber functionality and endless possibilities for accessorizing. And because it is a Weber, I know that with a little TLC, it will last for decades.
Results.Title: The Original; The Best

Results.ReviewText: Excellent product, practical and easy to use. Ideal for cooking with the family
Results.Title: Excellent product

14510601.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14510601.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
